summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 UX fixes on MOBILE (priority per E1 note) plus code-level verification on WEB. All 3 pass on both surfaces. MOBILE (browser-automation, viewport 390x844, owner login → dismissed Coming-Soon promo → skipped tour → Workspace tab → Risk Monitor): ISSUE 1 rm-stop-ananta button is GONE (query returns null both globally and scoped inside rm-safeguards); ee-stop-ananta remains in the page header. ISSUE 2 'save automatically' text is ABSENT (case-insensitive body innerText scan); toggling rm-regime-COMPRESSION triggered ZERO PUT/POST /api/settings requests (auto-save off); tapping rm-save-settings triggered exactly ONE PUT /api/settings with the full patch — persistence gated behind explicit user action. ISSUE 3 (mobile parity — pre-existing): wiz-use-live-exit Switch is present in the Research > Validate wizard, defaults to true (research.tsx:126), and the RUN payload sends use_live_exit_settings:true. WEB (code + prior iter75 report): rm-stop-ananta removed (grep across /app/frontend/src shows 0 occurrences); RiskMonitorPanel.jsx update() only patches local state, only saveAll() (rm-save-settings) calls api.updateSettings — no onBlur/onChange persistence; wizard-use-live-toggle + wizard-use-live-switch present in ResearchWizard.jsx step 4; researchStore.js:100+113 confirm when useLive=true, spec.use_live_exit_settings=true is set and exit_method is NOT included in the /api/lab/runs POST body (matches spec exactly).

parity_issues.flow: Research wizard RUN payload when useLive=true
parity_issues.issue: Mobile always sends BOTH `exit_method` and `use_live_exit_settings` in the /api/lab/runs POST regardless of the toggle state (research.tsx:162: `exit_method: exit, use_live_exit_settings: useLive`). Web drops `exit_method` entirely when useLive=true (researchStore.js:113: `if (method === 'live') spec.use_live_exit_settings = true; else spec.exit_method = method;`). Backend prioritises use_live_exit_settings and ignores the stray exit_method, so no functional bug — but the payload shape differs across surfaces which could confuse future backend log/analytics reads. LOW priority.
parity_issues.expected: When wiz-use-live-exit is ON, mobile posts { use_live_exit_settings: true } without exit_method (parity with web)
parity_issues.actual: Mobile posts { exit_method: 'atr', use_live_exit_settings: true } — exit_method key still present

action_items: LOW / parity: in /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/research.tsx:162, only include exit_method when !useLive (mirror web researchStore.js:113 shape) so the /api/lab/runs POST body is identical across surfaces. Purely cosmetic — backend behaviour is already correct because use_live_exit_settings=true takes priority.
critical_code_review_comments: RiskMonitorPanel.jsx L27: update() = local state only; L29-47 saveAll() is the ONLY caller of api.updateSettings — clean, no auto-save path. Comment on L25-26 explicitly documents the contract.

workspace.tsx (mobile) L459-460: save() and saveBool() = local setSettings only; L462-477 saveAll() is the ONLY caller of api.updateSettings. HOWEVER L526 still has the stale comment `// Save — changes also auto-save; this gives explicit confirmation` — code is correct but comment now lies. Suggest updating to match RiskMonitorPanel.jsx L91 (`Save — the ONLY thing that persists changes to the backend.`).

ResearchWizard.jsx L147-157: wizard-use-live-toggle is a Radix `<label>` wrapping the Switch — clicking anywhere on the card flips the switch, good affordance. L158 correctly disables (opacity-40, pointer-events-none, aria-disabled) the exit-strategy selector when useLive=true so the user visibly sees the override taking effect.
researchStore.js L100 chooses method='live' → L113 sets `spec.use_live_exit_settings=true` and skips `exit_method` — matches the spec `POST use_live_exit_settings:true with no exit_method` exactly.
Mobile research.tsx L162 sends both keys unconditionally — see parity_issues. Not a regression (matches pre-fix behaviour) but worth aligning.
